<?php
namespace BSRE\Enquiries;
if (!defined('ABSPATH')) exit;

const OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_AD_NOTICE = 'bsre-de-offplan-ads-preview-v1';
const OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_AD_PENDING = '__Host-bsre_de_offplan_ads_pending';

function offplan_country_ad_binding_id(string $path): int {
    // This private prototype only has a localized German consent disclosure.
    if ($path !== '/off-plan-dubai-de-de/' || !defined('BSRE_OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_ADVERTISING_BINDING')
        || !is_array(BSRE_OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_ADVERTISING_BINDING)) return 0;
    $id = offplan_country_native_page($path);
    if (!$id || BSRE_OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_ADVERTISING_BINDING !== [$path => $id]
        || offplan_country_public_url($path, $id) === '' || !ready()
        || owned_parent_url(privacy_url(), '/property-enquiry-privacy-notice/') === '') return 0;
    return $id;
}

function offplan_country_ad_id(string $path): int {
    return measurement_eligible() && measurement_public_configuration()['advertising_enabled'] ? offplan_country_ad_binding_id($path) : 0;
}

function offplan_country_ad_endpoint(string $path, string $phase): string {
    $suffix = offplan_country_rest_suffix($path, $phase);
    return owned_parent_url(rest_url('bsre/v1' . $suffix), '/wp-json/bsre/v1' . $suffix);
}

function offplan_country_ad_session(): string {
    $session = $_COOKIE[OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_COOKIE] ?? '';
    return is_string($session) && preg_match('/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/D', $session) ? $session : '';
}

function offplan_country_ad_subject(string $path, int $id, string $session): string {
    return hash_hmac('sha256', 'bsre-country-ads-subject-v1|' . $path . '|' . $id . '|' . $session, wp_salt('auth'));
}

function offplan_country_ad_snapshot(?array $row): array {
    $off = array_replace(consent_denied_snapshot(), ['notice_version' => OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_AD_NOTICE]);
    if (!$row || $row['notice_version'] !== OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_AD_NOTICE
        || (int) $row['expires_at'] <= time() || (int) $row['uncertain'] !== 0) return $off;
    $grant = (int) $row['ad_measurement'] === 1;
    return array_replace($off, ['preferences' => ['analytics' => false, 'ad_measurement' => $grant, 'personalization' => false],
        'known' => true, 'acknowledged' => true, 'measurement_eligible' => $grant,
        'decision_version' => $row['receipt'], 'preference_expires_at' => (int) $row['expires_at']]);
}

function offplan_country_ad_state(string $path, string $session = ''): array {
    $id = offplan_country_ad_id($path);
    $session = $session ?: offplan_country_ad_session();
    $empty = ['row' => null, 'snapshot' => offplan_country_ad_snapshot(null)];
    if (!$id || $session === '') return $empty;
    try {
        $store = consent_repository();
        $subject = offplan_country_ad_subject($path, $id, $session);
        $row = $store->current($subject);
        if (array_key_exists(OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_AD_PENDING, $_COOKIE)) {
            if ($row && (int) $row['ad_measurement'] === 1) {
                $store->choose($subject, ['analytics' => false, 'ad_measurement' => false], OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_AD_NOTICE, time(), true);
            }
            return $empty;
        }
        return ['row' => $row, 'snapshot' => offplan_country_ad_snapshot($row)];
    } catch (\Throwable $e) { return $empty; }
}

function offplan_country_ad_choice(\WP_REST_Request $request, string $path): \WP_REST_Response {
    if ($bad = offplan_country_transport_guard($request, $path, 'ad-choice')) return $bad;
    $id = offplan_country_ad_id($path);
    $session = offplan_country_ad_session();
    $token = (string) $request->get_header('x-bsre-csrf');
    if (!$id || !valid_csrf($token, $session, offplan_country_csrf_salt($path), time())) return reply(403, 'CONSENT_CSRF_FAILED');
    if (limited('country-ad-choice:' . $session, 60, 20)) return reply(429, 'RATE_LIMITED', true);
    $raw = $request->get_body();
    try {
        if (strlen($raw) > 512) throw new \InvalidArgumentException();
        $choice = consent_choice_object($raw);
        $keys = array_keys(get_object_vars($choice)); sort($keys);
        if ($keys !== ['ad_measurement','notice_version'] || !is_bool($choice->ad_measurement)
            || $choice->notice_version !== OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_AD_NOTICE) throw new \InvalidArgumentException();
    } catch (\Throwable $e) { return reply(400, 'CONSENT_INVALID'); }
    try {
        $row = consent_repository()->choose(offplan_country_ad_subject($path, $id, $session),
            ['analytics' => false, 'ad_measurement' => $choice->ad_measurement], OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_AD_NOTICE, time());
        if (!consent_set_cookie(OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_AD_PENDING, '', time() - 3600, false)) throw new \RuntimeException();
        return response(200, ['ok' => true] + offplan_country_ad_snapshot($row));
    } catch (\Throwable $e) { return reply(503, 'CONSENT_UNAVAILABLE'); }
}

function offplan_country_ad_marker(string $path, int $id, string $uuid): string {
    return substr(hash_hmac('sha256', 'bsre-country-ads-receipt-v1|' . $path . '|' . $id . '|' . strtolower($uuid), wp_salt('auth')), 0, 32);
}

function offplan_country_ad_stage(string $raw, object $payload, array $state, string $marker): array {
    $result = ['recorded' => false, 'conflict' => false, 'row' => null, 'repository' => null];
    try {
        $store = consent_repository();
        $current = $state['row'];
        $row = $store->stage(['request_id' => strtolower($payload->request_id), 'fingerprint' => hash('sha256', $raw),
            'subject_key' => $current['subject_key'], 'original_revision' => (int) $current['revision'],
            'decision_version' => $marker, 'notice_version' => OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_AD_NOTICE,
            'analytics' => 0, 'ad_measurement' => 1, 'preference_expires_at' => (int) $current['expires_at'],
            'eligible' => 1, 'known' => 1, 'created_at' => time(), 'uncertain' => 0] + consent_capture_clicks($payload, false, time()));
        return ['recorded' => true, 'conflict' => false, 'row' => $row, 'repository' => $store];
    } catch (\DomainException $e) { $result['conflict'] = true; }
    catch (\Throwable $e) { /* Intake cannot use an unrecorded positive capture. */ }
    return $result;
}

function offplan_country_ad_link(array $handle, array $receipt, string $raw, string $path, bool $release): array {
    $off = consent_denied_snapshot();
    try {
        if (!consent_valid_receipt_id($receipt['lead_id'] ?? null, 'BSRE-')
            || !consent_valid_receipt_id($receipt['event_id'] ?? null, 'evt_')) throw new \RuntimeException();
        $store = $handle['repository'];
        $seed = $handle['row'];
        $row = $store->link($seed['request_id'], $seed['fingerprint'], $receipt['lead_id'], $receipt['event_id']);
        if (!$release || ($row['was_already_accepted'] ?? null) !== false || !measurement_eligible($raw)
            || $row['notice_version'] !== OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_AD_NOTICE || (int) $row['uncertain'] !== 0
            || (int) $row['eligible'] !== 1 || (int) $row['ad_measurement'] !== 1
            || (int) $row['preference_expires_at'] <= time()) return $off;
        $state = offplan_country_ad_state($path);
        if (!$state['snapshot']['measurement_eligible'] || !hash_equals($row['subject_key'], $state['row']['subject_key'])
            || $store->revoked($row['subject_key'], (int) $row['original_revision'], 'ad_measurement')) return $off;
        return $state['snapshot'];
    } catch (\Throwable $e) { consent_mark_uncertain($handle); return $off; }
}

function offplan_country_ad_configuration(string $path): array {
    $runtime = offplan_country_ad_endpoint($path, 'ad-runtime');
    $status = offplan_country_ad_endpoint($path, 'ad-status');
    $choice = offplan_country_ad_endpoint($path, 'ad-choice');
    if (!offplan_country_ad_id($path) || $runtime === '' || $status === '' || $choice === '') return owned_parent_google_off();
    return array_replace(measurement_public_configuration(), ['analytics_enabled' => false, 'runtime_endpoint' => $runtime,
        'status_endpoint' => $status, 'choice_endpoint' => $choice, 'country_path' => $path,
        'country_notice_version' => OFFPLAN_COUNTRY_AD_NOTICE, 'country_privacy_url' => owned_parent_url(privacy_url(), '/property-enquiry-privacy-notice/')]);
}

add_action('rest_api_init', function (): void {
    $path = '/off-plan-dubai-de-de/';
    $routes = [
        'ad-choice' => ['POST', static fn ($request) => offplan_country_ad_choice($request, $path)],
        'ad-runtime' => ['GET', static fn ($request) => measurement_runtime($request, null, $path)],
        'ad-status' => ['POST', static fn ($request) => measurement_status($request, null, $path)],
    ];
    foreach ($routes as $phase => [$method,$callback]) {
        register_rest_route('bsre/v1', offplan_country_rest_suffix($path, $phase),
            ['methods' => $method, 'permission_callback' => '__return_true', 'callback' => $callback]);
    }
});
